content: Project at https://github.com/kimihiro64/bombieri-vinogradov, it uses the Vaughan/Siegel-Walfisz/Weighted Bombieri-Vinogradov route to obtain Maynard's bounded prime gap formulation. This one took about 3 days 19 hours from scratch on Codex 5.6 Sol Extra High, including locating source theorems and notes, planning, to fully compiled proof. Another day or so of final cleanup. About 45M tokens. It's built with a lot of organized helper theorems for reusability, already using it in another project to start proving new BV-like theorems for my other research.
(Please consider submitting to Palomar, and/or contributing a roadmap to Tau Ceti and setting some agents on upstreaming the reusable parts into Tau Ceti for others to build on!)
